turns.query: At Causeway Bay station (station_id 17) over June 2025, find the single hour timestamp with the highest NO2. Then compute the mean traffic speed (from the hourly road-segment traffic records) at that same timestamp across the road segments whose geometry lies within 300 metres of the station (non-NULL speed). Return that peak NO2 value (1 dp) and the mean speed (2 dp).
code_snippets:
import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# 1. Resolve station 17 (Causeway Bay) coordinates
station_query = text("""
SELECT id, name_en, address_en, coordinate::text as coordinate_text, altitude, station_type, area_type
FROM air_quality_station
WHERE id = 17
""")
station_17 = pd.read_sql(station_query, engine)
print("=== Station 17 (Causeway Bay) ===")
print(station_17[['id', 'name_en', 'address_en', 'altitude', 'station_type', 'area_type']])
print(f"Coordinate (WKT): {station_17['coordinate_text'].values[0]}")

# 2. Fetch hourly NO2 data for station 17 for June 2025
no2_query = text("""
SELECT datetime, station_id, no2, no2_ar
FROM hourly_station_air_quality
WHERE station_id = 17
AND datetime >= '2025-06-01 00:00:00'
AND datetime < '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
ORDER BY datetime
""")
no2_data = pd.read_sql(no2_query, engine)
print(f"\n=== NO2 Data for Station 17 (June 2025) ===")
print(f"Row count: {len(no2_data)}")
if len(no2_data) > 0:
    print(f"NO2 range: {no2_data['no2'].min():.1f} - {no2_data['no2'].max():.1f} µg/m³")
    print(f"NO2 mean: {no2_data['no2'].mean():.1f} µg/m³")
    print(f"Peak NO2 hour: {no2_data.loc[no2_data['no2'].idxmax(), 'datetime']}")
    print(no2_data.head())

# 3. Fetch hourly traffic data with road segment geometries for June 2025
# First, check how many road segments exist and their lengths
road_segments_query = text("""
SELECT rs.id, rs.road_segment_code, rs.length, rs.free_flow_speed, s.name_en as street_name
FROM road_segment rs
JOIN street s ON rs.street_id = s.id
LIMIT 20
""")
road_segments_sample = pd.read_sql(road_segments_query, engine)
print(f"\n=== Road Segments Sample ===")
print(road_segments_sample)

# Count road segments by length category
length_dist_query = text("""
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN length <= 300 THEN '<=300m'
        WHEN length <= 500 THEN '301-500m'
        WHEN length <= 1000 THEN '501-1000m'
        ELSE '>1000m'
    END as length_category,
    COUNT(*) as count
FROM road_segment
GROUP BY length_category
ORDER BY length_category
""")
length_dist = pd.read_sql(length_dist_query, engine)
print(f"\n=== Road Segment Length Distribution ===")
print(length_dist)

# Fetch traffic data for short segments (<=300m) for June 2025
traffic_query = text("""
SELECT hrst.road_segment_id, hrst.speed, hrst.congestion_status, hrst.congestion_index, hrst.datetime,
       rs.length, rs.road_segment_code, rs.geometry::text as geometry_text
FROM hourly_road_segment_traffic hrst
JOIN road_segment rs ON hrst.road_segment_id = rs.id
WHERE rs.length <= 300
AND hrst.datetime >= '2025-06-01 00:00:00'
AND hrst.datetime < '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
ORDER BY hrst.datetime, hrst.road_segment_id
""")
traffic_data = pd.read_sql(traffic_query, engine)
print(f"\n=== Traffic Data for Segments <=300m (June 2025) ===")

    print(f"Speed range: {traffic_data['speed'].min():.2f} - {traffic_data['speed'].max():.2f} m/s")
    print(f"Speed mean: {traffic_data['speed'].mean():.2f} m/s")
    print(f"Unique road segments: {traffic_data['road_segment_id'].nunique()}")
    print(f"Unique hours: {traffic_data['datetime'].nunique()}")
    print(traffic_data.head(10))

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# 1. Confirm peak NO2 hour for station 17 in June 2025
peak_no2_query = text("""
SELECT datetime, no2
FROM hourly_station_air_quality
WHERE station_id = 17
AND datetime >= '2025-06-01 00:00:00'
AND datetime < '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
ORDER BY no2 DESC
LIMIT 5
""")
peak_no2_data = pd.read_sql(peak_no2_query, engine)
print("=== Top 5 Peak NO2 Hours (Station 17, June 2025) ===")
print(peak_no2_data)

# Extract peak NO2 value and datetime
peak_datetime = peak_no2_data['datetime'].values[0]
peak_no2_value = peak_no2_data['no2'].values[0]
print(f"\nPeak NO2: {peak_no2_value:.1f} µg/m³ at {peak_datetime}")

# 2. Fetch traffic data for segments <=300m at the peak NO2 hour
# Use aggregation directly in SQL to avoid timeout
traffic_agg_query = text("""
SELECT 
    AVG(hrst.speed) as mean_speed,
    COUNT(*) as segment_hour_count,
    MIN(hrst.speed) as min_speed,
    MAX(hrst.speed) as max_speed
FROM hourly_road_segment_traffic hrst
JOIN road_segment rs ON hrst.road_segment_id = rs.id
WHERE rs.length <= 300
AND hrst.datetime = '2025-06-03 19:00:00'
""")
traffic_agg = pd.read_sql(traffic_agg_query, engine)
print("\n=== Traffic Aggregation for Peak NO2 Hour (2025-06-03 19:00) ===")
print(traffic_agg)

# 3. Also fetch the actual traffic data for verification (limited)
traffic_sample_query = text("""
SELECT hrst.road_segment_id, hrst.speed, rs.length, rs.road_segment_code
FROM hourly_road_segment_traffic hrst
JOIN road_segment rs ON hrst.road_segment_id = rs.id
WHERE rs.length <= 300
AND hrst.datetime = '2025-06-03 19:00:00'
ORDER BY hrst.speed
LIMIT 20
""")
traffic_sample = pd.read_sql(traffic_sample_query, engine)
print("\n=== Sample Traffic Data at Peak Hour (sorted by speed) ===")
print(traffic_sample)

# Stage results for synthesis agent
cwb_peak_no2 = round(float(peak_no2_value), 1)
cwb_peak_speed = round(float(traffic_agg['mean_speed'].values[0]), 2) if len(traffic_agg) > 0 and pd.notna(traffic_agg['mean_speed'].values[0]) else None

print(f"\n=== STAGED RESULTS ===")
print(f"cwb_peak_no2 = {cwb_peak_no2}")
print(f"cwb_peak_speed = {cwb_peak_speed}")

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Step 2: Find peak NO2 hour in June 2025
# June 2025: from 2025-06-01 00:00:00 to 2025-07-01 00:00:00 (exclusive)
peak_no2_query = text("""
SELECT datetime, no2
FROM hourly_station_air_quality
WHERE station_id = 17
AND datetime >= '2025-06-01 00:00:00'
AND datetime < '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
ORDER BY no2 DESC
LIMIT 1
""")
peak_no2_data = pd.read_sql(peak_no2_query, engine)
print(f"Peak NO2 data:\n{peak_no2_data}")

peak_no2_value = peak_no2_data['no2'].values[0]
print(f"Peak datetime: {peak_datetime}, Peak NO2: {peak_no2_value}")

# Step 3: Find road segments within 300m of station
road_segments_query = text("""
SELECT rs.id, rs.length, rs.geometry
FROM road_segment rs
WHERE ST_DWithin(
    rs.geometry::geography,
    ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(%s, %s), 4326)::geography,
    300
)
""")
# Need to extract lon/lat from the geography point

SELECT ST_X(coordinate::geometry) as lon, ST_Y(coordinate::geometry) as lat
FROM air_quality_station
WHERE id = 17

FROM hourly_road_segment_traffic hrt
JOIN road_segment rs ON hrt.road_segment_id = rs.id
WHERE ST_DWithin(
    rs.geometry::geography,
    ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(%s, %s), 4326)::geography,
    300
)
AND rs.length <= 300
AND hrt.datetime = '%s'
AND hrt.speed IS NOT NULL
""")
speed_df = pd.read_sql(speed_query, engine, params=[cwb_lon, cwb_lat, peak_datetime])
print(f"Speed records at peak: {len(speed_df)}")
print(f"Speed data:\n{speed_df}")

if len(speed_df) > 0:
    mean_speed = speed_df['speed'].mean()
else:
    mean_speed = None
    print("No speed data found!")

print(f"\n=== FINAL RESULTS ===")
print(f"Peak NO2: {peak_no2_value} (rounded to 1dp: {round(peak_no2_value, 1)})")
print(f"Mean speed: {mean_speed} (rounded to 2dp: {round(mean_speed, 2) if mean_speed else None})")

# Assign to required variables
cwb_peak_no2 = round(peak_no2_value, 1)
cwb_peak_speed = round(mean_speed, 2) if mean_speed else None
